package_info.package_manager: malicious Windows executable (delivered via Microsoft Word OLE object)
package_info.why_malicious: AstraLocker 2.0 is ransomware that encrypts user files, deletes backups, disables security tools, and demands cryptocurrency payment for decryption. It is delivered via phishing emails with malicious Microsoft Word documents, and executes immediately upon user interaction, causing data loss and extortion.

execution_context.trigger: user double-clicks embedded executable in Word document
execution_context.file_location: OLE object inside malicious Microsoft Word document

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At initial execution, the code checks for virtual machine environments, sandbox analysis, and running analysis tools, then terminates if detected, evading automated analysis.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Legitimate software rarely checks for virtual machines or analysis tools to avoid execution; this is a common anti-analysis and anti-VM evasion tactic in malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal applications do not attempt to evade security analysis or terminate themselves based on the environment.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some DRM or licensing software may check for VMs to prevent piracy, but not in this context.
key_indicators: Process/window name checks for analysis tools

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: for each service in [backup, anti-malware]: stopService(service); for each process in [interfering_processes]: killProcess(process);
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code stops backup and anti-malware services and kills processes that could interfere with file encryption, disabling system defenses.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Disabling security and backup services is a hallmark of ransomware, aiming to maximize damage and prevent recovery.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate software should not indiscriminately stop security or backup services.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate uninstallers may stop their own services, but not unrelated security/backup services.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Before encrypting files, the code deletes volume shadow copies and empties the recycle bin, removing local backup and recovery options.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Deleting shadow copies and recycle bin is a classic ransomware tactic to prevent file recovery.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal applications do not delete system backups or user recycle bin contents without explicit user consent.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Disk cleanup utilities may empty the recycle bin, but not delete shadow copies without user approval.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: for each drive in enumerateDrivesAndShares(): mount(drive); for each file in drive: encryptFile(file, curve25519_key);
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: During the main encryption phase, the code enumerates and mounts all drives and network shares, then encrypts files using Curve25519 ECC, rendering user data inaccessible.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Encrypting user files and network shares is the core behavior of ransomware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate software does not encrypt user files or network shares without user intent.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Backup software may access and copy files, but not encrypt them with unknown keys.
key_indicators: Use of strong ECC (Curve25519) for encryption

attack_chain.action: User receives phishing email with malicious Word document and opens it.
User double-clicks the OLE-embedded executable, launching the ransomware payload.
Ransomware checks for VM, sandbox, and analysis tools; exits if detected.
Ransomware stops backup and anti-malware services, kills interfering processes.
attack_chain.leads_to: Deletes shadow copies and empties recycle bin.

attack_chain.action: Ransomware deletes volume shadow copies and empties the recycle bin.
attack_chain.leads_to: Enumerates and mounts drives and network shares.

attack_chain.action: Ransomware enumerates and mounts all drives and network shares.
Ransomware encrypts files on all accessible drives and network shares.
attack_chain.leads_to: Files are inaccessible; ransom note is displayed.

behavioral_signatures: Executable launched from OLE object in Office document
Immediate anti-VM, anti-sandbox, and anti-analysis checks
Bulk termination of backup and anti-malware services
Enumeration and mounting of all drives and network shares
file_indicators: Malicious Word documents with embedded OLE executables
network_indicators: Possible C2 or payment instructions in ransom note
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Office documents containing OLE-embedded executables, especially those that launch processes upon user interaction. Detect processes that immediately perform anti-VM or anti-analysis checks, stop backup/anti-malware services, delete shadow copies, and enumerate/encrypt files across all drives and network shares. Flag files with the .babyk extension and correlate with known malicious hashes. Alert on network activity referencing known cryptocurrency wallet addresses associated with ransomware.
